# K.R. Mangalam University

> K.R. Mangalam University (KRMU) is a NAAC 'A'-accredited, UGC-recognised private university in Gurugram, Haryana, established in 2013. It offers 100+ multidisciplinary undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programmes across 12 schools, with a placement record of 800+ recruiters and a highest package of 56.6 LPA.

Key facts: 13+ years of educational experience, 35-acre urban campus on Sohna Road, 700+ faculty, 18,000+ alumni worldwide, 100+ research labs, 4,000+ research publications, 250+ patents granted, â‚¹16Cr+ in research and consultancy grants.

## Schools & Programmes
- [All Programmes](https://www.krmangalam.edu.in/programmes): Full catalog of UG, PG, and doctoral programmes across all schools.
- [School of Engineering & Technology](https://www.krmangalam.edu.in/school-of-engineering-and-technology): B.Tech/M.Tech in CSE, Mechanical, Civil, Electronics & Communication, and allied branches.
- [School of Management & Commerce](https://www.krmangalam.edu.in/school-of-management-and-commerce): BBA, MBA, B.Com, and related management/commerce programmes.
- [School of Legal Studies](https://www.krmangalam.edu.in/school-of-legal-studies): BA LLB, BBA LLB, and LLM programmes.
- [School of Medical & Allied Sciences](https://www.krmangalam.edu.in/school-of-medical-and-allied-sciences): B.Pharm, M.Pharm, D.Pharm, and allied health science programmes.
- [School of Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation Sciences](https://www.krmangalam.edu.in/school-of-physiotherapy-and-rehabilitation-sciences): BPT, MPT, and rehabilitation science programmes.
- [School of Liberal Arts](https://www.krmangalam.edu.in/school-of-liberal-arts): Psychology, English, Journalism & Mass Communication, and humanities programmes.
- [School of Architecture & Design](https://www.krmangalam.edu.in/school-of-architecture-design): B.Arch and design programmes.
- [School of Basic & Applied Sciences](https://www.krmangalam.edu.in/school-of-basic-and-applied-sciences): B.Sc./M.Sc. in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Forensic Science, and Cyber Security.
- [School of Emerging Media & Creator Economy](https://www.krmangalam.edu.in/school-of-emerging-media-and-creator-economy): Programmes in digital media, content creation, and the creator economy.
- [School of Hotel Management & Catering Technology](https://www.krmangalam.edu.in/school-of-hotel-management-and-catering-technology): BHMCT and hospitality management programmes.
- [School of Education](https://www.krmangalam.edu.in/school-of-education): B.Ed and teacher-training programmes.
- [School of Agricultural Sciences](https://www.krmangalam.edu.in/school-of-agriculutural-sciences): B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture and allied programmes.
- [Zenith School of AI](https://zenithschool.ai/): KRMU's dedicated school for Artificial Intelligence education.
